profile_text.body:
Uber Technologies, Inc is a publicly traded company (ticker UBER, CIK 0001543151) headquartered in San Francisco, California. On its own site, Uber describes a platform and apps that let people earn, eat, commute, get a ride, and simplify business travel. The company also says it is introducing autonomous vehicles on Uber, describing them as a key part of the future of movement, and says it is partnering with industry leaders on a safety-driven approach that combines autonomous vehicles and drivers.

The site material does not name specific AI products, and no products are listed in the company's tracked record. Its stated autonomous-vehicle work is the main technology direction described on the site, framed by the company as a partnership-based effort rather than a product it builds alone.

Litigation records associated with the company list 281 cases in California. No lawsuits are otherwise itemized in the record, and no MCP servers are listed.
